chitchat: hefts a spare missile onto her shoulder and checks the fins.
"Keep it fed, keep it hungry. That's the whole job."
description: A wiry Redline loader with a rack of spare missiles and grease to the elbows. She reloads the nest between shots faster than anyone has a right to.

bye.text: They turn back to the guns and the sky.

root.text: They keep one eye on the sky. "Unless you're here to help work the guns, you're in the way. Move."

name: a Redline loader
